$comment: Official vendor marks, the third source of scripts/gen-vendor-marks.mjs. Each SVG here was taken from the company's own site, brand page or brand kit on the date shown, then normalised to a 24 x 24 currentColor file (transforms applied, uniform scale, centred, strokes outlined, symbol isolated from a lockup where the brand itself uses the symbol alone). Shapes are never redrawn. sha256 is of the file as downloaded (for an inline header logo, of the <svg> element as cut from the page, with xmlns added where the element lacked it). docs/ui/VENDOR-MARKS.md holds the coverage table and the usage policy.

ofBeyondPresence.title: Beyond Presence
ofBeyondPresence.form: Symbol isolated from the header lockup. The site uses the symbol alone as its app icon.
ofBeyondPresence.colours: White in the original, drawn in one ink here.

ofCartesia.title: Cartesia
ofCartesia.guidelines: https://www.cartesia.ai/brand forbids recolouring or distorting Archie without written permission. The kit ships approved black and white versions, which is what the foreground ink renders (dark on light, light on dark).
ofCartesia.form: Standalone brand symbol (Archie) from the official kit.
ofCartesia.colours: Black version used. Kit also has white and green (#309D4B).

ofComposio.title: Composio
ofComposio.guidelines: https://brand.composio.dev/guidelines asks for black on light and white on dark, the logomark for tight spaces, and no recolouring. The foreground ink renders exactly that.
ofComposio.form: Standalone logomark. Its stroke was outlined to a filled shape (same geometry).

ofDid.title: D-ID
ofDid.form: Full logo, which D-ID also uses as its favicon. There is no separate symbol.
ofDid.colours: White and orange (#FF882E) in the original, drawn in one ink here.

ofHume.title: Hume
ofHume.form: Symbol (seven dots) isolated from the header lockup. The site uses the dots alone as its favicon.

ofInworld.title: Inworld
ofInworld.form: Symbol isolated from the header lockup. The site uses the symbol alone as its favicon.

ofPinecone.title: Pinecone
ofPinecone.form: Symbol isolated from the header lockup. The site uses the symbol alone as its favicon.
ofPinecone.colours: The site's text colour (one ink) in the original.

ofRagie.title: Ragie
ofRagie.form: Symbol isolated from the header lockup, strokes outlined to filled shapes (same geometry). The site uses the symbol alone as its app icon.
ofRagie.colours: Green, grey and blue circles with light lines in the original, drawn in one ink here.

ofRime.title: Rime
ofRime.form: Full wordmark. Rime has no separate symbol and uses the wordmark as its favicon.

ofSpeechify.title: Speechify
ofSpeechify.guidelines: https://speechify.com/brand-kit/ recommends the black or white monochrome versions for most uses, which is what the foreground ink renders.
ofSpeechify.form: Standalone logomark from the official kit.
ofSpeechify.colours: Black version used. Kit also has white and blue.

ofSpeechmatics.title: Speechmatics
ofSpeechmatics.guidelines: https://www.speechmatics.com/brand forbids changing the logo colours and approves black and white versions, which is what the foreground ink renders. Its black and white SVG downloads embed a raster image, so the geometry comes from the vector main logo.
ofSpeechmatics.form: Symbol isolated from the lockup. The site uses the symbol alone as its favicon.
ofSpeechmatics.colours: Dark teal (#0D3C48) in the main logo, drawn as the approved black or white version here.

ofTavus.title: Tavus
ofTavus.guidelines: The kit has no written guidelines. It ships dark and white symbol versions.
ofTavus.form: Standalone symbol from the official kit.

ofWeaviate.title: Weaviate
ofWeaviate.form: Symbol isolated from the header lockup. The site uses the symbol alone as its favicon.
ofWeaviate.colours: Green gradient in the original, drawn in one ink here.

ofZilliz.title: Zilliz
ofZilliz.guidelines: https://zilliz.com/brand-assets says downloading its kits means agreeing to its terms, so the kits were not used. The header logo on the public site was used instead.
ofZilliz.form: Symbol isolated from the header lockup. The site uses the symbol alone as its favicon.
ofZilliz.colours: Gradient in the original, drawn in one ink here.
